name: The simple planning engine: one standalone single-file tool that agents and the Leader share to plan the Group's work as a triplet graph
asks: Leader, 2026-09-10: "I want, under dev/apps/simple-planning-engine/, to create a simple planning engine that you and Codex can interact with via MCP, and me via simple web forms. I want this NOT TETHERED AT ALL to our existing code". Leader, 2026-09-22: "the simple-planning-engine is meant to be a single-file standalone tool for helping you and other agents coordinate this work." Full words by address in provenance.

x-provenance.recorded-by: metroplat-feltos-node pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group has one simple planning engine, standalone, theory-grounded and used before work is done.

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall be a single Node file with no dependencies, held under dev/apps/simple-planning-engine/.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "under dev/apps/simple-planning-engine/ … just a simple Node script, but honestly single-file would be great"; 2026-09-10 (later): "a single-file robust node script with no dependencies"; 2026-09-22: "a single-file standalone tool".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall share no code, package or runtime with the rest of the codebase, so that work on the codebase cannot break it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "NOT TETHERED AT ALL to our existing code, so that working on the code does not affect it at all"; "our planning tools don't break when we work on the codebase … keep it totally a standalone tool, even if it shares, conceptually, data types and such".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall expose its operations to agents through MCP.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "that you and Codex can interact with via MCP".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall expose its operations to the Leader through simple web forms.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "and me via simple web forms".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall model endeavors, campaigns and every level down to workitems with their component objects, using the morphisms of the house's theories of working, planning, doing and governing.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "Use our best theories of working, planning, doing, governing, from our science section - the actual theories of the science and math, not the … implementation notes and specification slop … endeavors, campaigns, etc., all the way down to workitems with their component objects … using the proper morphisms from our theories".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall create, read, update and delete each of its data types.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "You should be able to then CRUD each data type within our planning engine".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall store its data as triplets forming one graph of how all the Group's work relates.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "the data should be triplets so we end up with a rich triplet graph of how all our work relates".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall provide the basic operational tooling needed to plan and execute the work on the rest of the codebase.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "Invest HEAVILY in this tool, such that it can provide the basic operational tooling we need to plan and execute the work necessary to do to the rest of the codebase".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall be one planning tool that agents share, so that the Group does not make intricate competing planning tools.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "one … simple planning engine that you and other agents could share so that we STOP spinning our wheels making intricate crap".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall start without a driver script in another language and shall not list hundreds of tasks marked as current.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10: "why I'm seeing a driver.py … 445 tasks labeled NOW? This is useless".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall stay within memory and latency bounds that let it run beside the rest of the machine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22: it is "broken, slow, inefficient", it OOMs and is "so slow and … contain[s] such little meaningful information".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall receive each Leader prompt as planned work before the work it plans is performed.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22: "UNACCEPTABLE to keep leaving it broken … or deferring its use until after you have done the work it exists to plan … PLAN the work. Like actually plan it, and then do what the plans say"; "the user's prompts are not entering the planning tool, knowledge is not being used".

conditions.says: A reader finds one Node file with no dependencies, a CRUD operation per data type over MCP and web forms, and triplet storage.
The file runs with the rest of the repository absent.
A prompt of the Leader is found as work in the engine's graph before its work begins.

board-opening.context: Not held before this record outside the articulation index and two notes (2026-09-20 classification note, 2026-10-03 note on how the node changes itself). The engine is in the engineering category; the theories it realizes are in the science sections for working, planning, doing and governing (the relationality agency/animating notes).
